svg.title: Client, worker and DTS roles with local worker configuration
svg.desc: Conceptual roles view of the public contract, not a network trace or a required process layout. The application client requests a workflow from DTS. The worker asks DTS for work with its configured eligibility and reports outcomes. DTS delivers eligible work. The worker SDK uses its own local task registry, filters and optional version policy. Those configuration elements belong to the worker, not the DTS service. Solid arrows show role interactions. Dashed links associate local configuration with the worker runtime and do not describe an order of internal checks. The client and worker roles may share a process.
